import json, sys, time, subprocess, base64, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest

NENTRIES = 32
NSTRUCT = 63
NFIELDS = 16
RUNS_PER = 64
NSTATES = 4096
NTRANS = 16384

types = [
  {"name": "U16", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
  {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 8},
  {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": ["q%04d" % i for i in range(NSTATES)]},
  {"name": "Big", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["f%d" % i, "U16"] for i in range(NFIELDS)]},
  {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Big", "size": NSTRUCT},
]
modules = []
for e in range(NENTRIES):
    name = "entry%02d" % e
    modules.append({"name": name,
                    "params": [["state", "State"], ["msg", "Str"], ["blk", "Arr"]],
                    "result": ["r", "U16"],
                    "requires": ["lt", ["index", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U16", 0]],
                                        ["field", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U16", 0]], "f0"],
                                        ] if False else ["field", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U16", 0]], "f0"],
                                    ["const", "U16", 60000]]})
# fix the requires expression properly
for m in modules:
    m["requires"] = ["lt", ["field", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U16", 0]], "f0"],
                     ["const", "U16", 60000]]
transitions = []
for i in range(NTRANS):
    transitions.append({"from": "q%04d" % (i % NSTATES), "to": "q%04d" % ((i * 7 + 3) % NSTATES),
                        "command": "c%03d" % (i % 900), "cost": 1 + (i % 9),
                        "when": ["lt", ["field", ["index", ["var", "blk"], ["const", "U16", 0]], "f0"],
                                 ["const", "U16", 60000]] if i % 4 == 0 else None})
for i in range(NSTATES - 1):
    transitions[i] = {"from": "q%04d" % i, "to": "q%04d" % (i + 1), "command": "a%03d" % (i % 900),
                      "cost": 1, "when": None}
machine = {"states": ["q%04d" % i for i in range(NSTATES)], "initial": "q0000",
           "state_param": "state", "message_param": "msg", "transitions": transitions}
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [],
       "entries": [m["name"] for m in modules], "machine": machine, "runs": []}
json.dump(doc, open('/workspace/tmp/max.json', 'w'))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"],
                   stdin=open('/workspace/tmp/max.json', 'rb'), capture_output=True)
plan = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())["plans"][0]
names = [s[0] for s in plan["slots"]]
widths = {s[0]: s[2] for s in plan["slots"]}
print("plan variables", plan["variables"], "slots", len(names), "x", NENTRIES,
      "-> total", plan["variables"] * NENTRIES, len(names) * NENTRIES)

runs = []
total = 0
for e in range(NENTRIES):
    entry = "entry%02d" % e
    for k in range(RUNS_PER):
        objs = []
        for name in names:
            w = widths[name]
            if name == "x0":
                value = (k * 137 + e) % NSTATES
            elif w == 1:
                value = 0x61 + ((k + e) % 20) if int(name[1:]) < 6 else 0
            else:
                value = (k * 31 + e * 7 + int(name[1:])) % 30000
            objs.append((name, value.to_bytes(w, 'little')))
        runs.append({"entry": entry, "ktest": ktest(objs)})
        total += 1
doc["runs"] = runs
json.dump(doc, open('/workspace/tmp/max.json', 'w'))
print("runs", total, "input size %.1f MiB" % (os.path.getsize('/workspace/tmp/max.json') / 1048576))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"],
                   stdin=open('/workspace/tmp/max.json', 'rb'), capture_output=True)
print("elapsed %.2fs rc=%d stderr=%s" % (time.time() - t, p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:300]))
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(r["status"] for r in out["records"]))
print("corpus", len(out["corpus"]))
print("output size %.1f MiB" % (len(p.stdout) / 1048576))
PYEOF
